model: Holdco NAV compounding x exit price-to-NAV at cost of equity, plus dividends
methodology_note: Insurer/holdco row of the dcf-methods routing table (BVPS compounding x exit P/B), with the company's own adjusted NAV per share as the book: 93.5% of holdco assets are listed stakes or cash at market, and IFRS book carries Great-West/IGM at ~1/3 of market. IV = PV(dividends Y1-5) + NAV/share Y5 x (1 - exit discount), discounted at the CAD cost of equity. No net debt deducted (holdco debentures C$897m, other liabilities and C$4.18bn of perpetual prefs are inside adjusted NAV).

inputs.share_count_basis: 629.5M participating shares at 30-Jun-2026 (54.86M Participating Preferred + Subordinate Voting) + 4.2M treasury-method dilution (Q2-26 diluted 634.4M vs basic 630.2M weighted). 627.7M basic at the Q2 MD&A date after NCIB purchases; buybacks are modelled inside NAV/share growth.

nav_mark_detail.note: Listed stakes re-marked from the Q2-2026 adjusted-NAV table (MD&A A57-58) to Yahoo closes of 9-Oct-2026; private/fintech/cash/liabilities held at 30-Jun values.

inputs.holdco_net_debt_note: Holdco cash C$2,196m vs debentures C$897m + perpetual/non-participating prefs C$4,180m at 30-Jun-2026 -- all already netted inside adjusted NAV, so net_debt=0 here to avoid a double deduction.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual, share-based payments note (line 13061): C$19m; expensed in adjusted net earnings; immaterial to a NAV model
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 C$711m; H1-2026 C$882m (C$142m share capital + C$740m retained earnings, incl. ASPP obligation) -- pace ~C$1.3-1.7bn/yr annualised, ~2% of NAV. Base keeps 1%/yr of NAV as a sustainable rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: CAD cost of equity: Government of Canada 10y ~3.3% + 5.0% ERP x beta ~1.0 + ~0.5% for controlled dual-class structure = ~9% base (bull 8.5%, bear 10%).
inputs.lease_treatment: n/a (NAV model; leases sit inside subsidiaries' market values)
inputs.nci_treatment: Look-through NAV counts only POW's 68.6% of Great-West and 63.9% of IGM at market, so the C$20bn+ of consolidated NCI never enters the valuation.
inputs.notes: MODEL: holdco NAV compounding x exit P/NAV (insurer/holdco row of dcf-methods routing). Owner-FCF DCF rejected: consolidated revenue/OCF are Great-West's insurance flows, ~2/3 attributable to POW, and its debt/deposits are policy funding. First valuation of POW.TO (no memory entry). IFRS4->IFRS17 break FY2022->FY2023 and Feb-2020 reorganisation (shares 427M->677M) make the IFRS history non-comparable; the NAV series is only disclosed from FY2023 here.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case NAV/share growth (look-through earnings growth at partially de-rating multiples)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (0.6% 3yr / 1.9% 5yr) diverges far more than 30% from adjusted EPS CAGR (23.0% / 11.6%). IFRS equity excludes the market value of Great-West/IGM, was cut by the IFRS4->IFRS17 transition (FY2023 restatement) and is shrunk by ~C$0.4-0.9bn/yr of buybacks; it is not the growth anchor for a holdco.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue is consolidated insurance-company revenue (IFRS4 to FY2022, IFRS17 from FY2023) and is not a holdco value driver. Consolidated OCF-capex 'FCF' is dominated by Great-West's insurance float and is meaningless at the POW level, so no owner-FCF/SBC adjustment applies (holdco SBC ~C$19-23m/yr, expensed in adjusted earnings). NAV/share 53.53 -> 85.77 (FY23-25) -> 112.94 (Jun-26) is mostly a Great-West re-rating, not repeatable compounding.

bear.exit_pb_note: Exit price / adjusted NAV per share (not IFRS book: IFRS BVPS carries Great-West and IGM at book, ~1/3 of market).
bear.wacc_note: Cost of equity; flows are per-share dividends and exit equity value, so no net debt is deducted (holdco debt/prefs are already inside adjusted NAV).
bear.terminal_growth_note: Used only for the 15%-hurdle exit value (distribution Gordon); the intrinsic value exits on P/NAV.
bear.narrative: Great-West de-rates to ~12x (its pre-2025 range), Mackenzie/IG flows weaken and GBL keeps shrinking: NAV/share only +2%/yr, dividend +4%/yr, buybacks slow to 0.75% of NAV, and the discount reverts to the 30%-plus the stock carried pre-reorganisation (0.70x NAV). Cost of equity 10%.

base.exit_pb_note: Exit price / adjusted NAV per share (not IFRS book: IFRS BVPS carries Great-West and IGM at book, ~1/3 of market).
base.wacc_note: Cost of equity; flows are per-share dividends and exit equity value, so no net debt is deducted (holdco debt/prefs are already inside adjusted NAV).
base.terminal_growth_note: Used only for the 15%-hurdle exit value (distribution Gordon); the intrinsic value exits on P/NAV.
base.narrative: NAV/share compounds 6%/yr from C$110.32: Great-West base EPS growth ~8%/yr plus subsidiary dividends (~3.5% of NAV) less holdco costs/pref dividends (~0.7%), less POW's own dividend (~2.4%), plus ~0.25%/yr accretion from buying back ~1% of NAV at a ~20% discount -- ~8.5% at constant multiples, cut to 6% for partial de-rating of Great-West from ~16x forward earnings toward its 10-13x history. Dividend grows 7%/yr (FY23-26 pace was ~9%). Exit at 0.78x NAV (22% discount; observed 18-22% over 2025-26, wider historically). Cost of equity 9%.

bear.note: Per-share CAD. Buybacks are a memo line: they are already inside NAV/share growth (accretive below NAV), so they are NOT added to value.

base.note: Per-share CAD. Buybacks are a memo line: they are already inside NAV/share growth (accretive below NAV), so they are NOT added to value.

entry_price.method: Dividends Y1-5 at 15% + exit value a 15%-hurdle buyer would pay: next-year (dividend + buyback per share) / (0.15 - terminal growth), capped at the scenario's P/NAV exit. Not the base-case exit discount reused.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 25/50/25 rather than the 15/50/35 house default: the bull case needs Great-West to hold a multiple already above its history, while the bear (de-rating plus discount reversion) is the long-run norm for this stock, so the tails are weighted symmetrically.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street bases coincide: holdco SBC is ~C$20m/yr and the NAV model has no SBC add-back, so the band collapsed.

valuation_philosophy.summary: POW is a listed wrapper around Great-West (~78% of NAV) and IGM (~17%). At C$89 it trades at ~19% below a marked look-through NAV of ~C$110 -- inside its recent 18-22% range, so the market is already paying close to fair for the wrapper. The value case is entirely a Great-West case; the margin of safety would come from a wider discount, not from POW-level growth.
key_risks_to_valuation: Great-West re-rating reverses: a 10% move in listed holdings moves NAV ~C$11/share (company disclosure).
Wealthsimple/Sagard/Power Sustainable marks are private (Level 3); fintech markdowns hit NAV.
Dual-class control: minority holders cannot force discount-closing actions.
NAV ignores latent capital-gains tax on Great-West/IGM (IAS 12 note) and capitalised holdco costs.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 60.51-97.66
data_sources.financials: POW Q2-2026 report (adjusted NAV table, MD&A A57-58; share counts A56-57; selected financial information A2), FY2015-FY2025 annual reports via POW.TO_Metrics.csv / kpis
data_sources.holding_prices: Yahoo Finance GWO.TO, IGM.TO, GBLB.BR, EURCAD=X closes 30-Jun-2026 and 9-Oct-2026

required_return_table.note: Base exit at 0.78x NAV held constant; only the discount rate varies.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
